description: For frozen L9H7 rank96 pooled-edit cut, exact output-isometric gauges encode each native edit delta, retain its k largest absolute output-coordinate axes, reconstruct only those axes in head-state space, and patch them into the same native base model. Selectors use no family or answer labels. Compare final-logit path to full rank96 projected-delta patch and to full native-delta patch. Familiar panel has 12 independent cases per ten known types; unseen panel has 12 per ten whole-held-out designed types. All gauges share the same full rank96 reduced function.
